note: Video fixture mail, appended to the Demo folder of the demo mailbox by `npm run seed`. The same mailbox holds the OpenAI reviewer corpus in INBOX, Archive and Sent, whose counts the review test cases check, so video mail lives in its own folder and seed never touches the corpus: it removes and re-adds only messages FROM the exact sender addresses below, so no sender here may also appear in that corpus (nora.feldt@bergentek.example, escalations@helpdesk.example and sam.okafor@northwind-labs.example are taken). Every sender is on a .example domain (RFC 2606, unregistrable). ageHours is how long before the seed each message is dated, so 'today' stays today on every run. Keep subjects free of prices and plan talk: a chat scene may quote them on camera.
